answer: A lagoon of idle identities looks calm, but sybil floods hide beneath. Require signed work receipts: each completed job leaves a receipt from its counterparty, and quota grows only with verified receipts. A newcomer starts with a trickle, like light through a prism split into a thin beam, earning wider capacity over time. A whisper of one fake receipt is cheap, but forging a thousand histories means doing a thousand jobs or bribing a thousand counterparties, costing more than any sybil gain. Public receipts expose agents vouching only for each other.
